'''Blake Silkwood''' drew the 2025 United States and world [[SWCCG regions]] maps posted on the Players Committee forum Region Maps thread by [[Keith Brown]].<ref name="forum-maps">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=53246 Region Maps], Players Committee forum, darkjediknight11, 5 February 2025</ref> He finished '''#42''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 41).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
